iphone_se: Every button is big enough and reachable now, but Pets and Backpack are crowded and their small print (+100, item lines) is hard to read
iphone_new: Roomy and clean; the run screen reads well, only the Pets panel's small print stays tiny
android_old: Smallest screen (280 px under Roblox's bar): all taps 36-44 px now, but panels are dense and captions tiny
android_new: Studio's S25 Ultra preset is as small as the A06 (685x338): same as the cheap Android
ipad_old: Readable, nothing cut, thumbs free; panels leave the lobby buttons peeking out below
ipad_pro: Big and clear; the HUD stops growing at 1.3x so there is a lot of empty screen
xbox_1080: Everything inside the TV-safe frame with a controller badge on every action; panel text is small from the sofa
xbox_4k: Same as the Xbox at 1080 with PlayStation button names; a real 4K screen could not be emulated
tv_touch: Works, but on a big touch TV the HUD is small in the corners (it stops at 1.3x)
pc_laptop: Clean at 1365x768; ability names sit under their icons and item descriptions are small
